faqs.q: What makes your filter coffee extraction different?
faqs.a: We use estate-grade Arabica and Robusta roasted in micro-lots, brewed through traditional stainless-steel and brass gravity filters. The slow, drop-by-drop extraction gives a full-bodied, low-acidity decoction with a sweeter finish.

faqs.q: How is your nitro cold brew made?
faqs.a: Our cold brew steeps for 24 hours, is filtered twice, then infused with nitrogen and served on tap. The tiny nitrogen bubbles give it a naturally creamy texture — no dairy or sugar needed.

faqs.q: Can I get decaf or low-caffeine options?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep a Swiss-water decaf on espresso, and our chicory-heavy filter blend is lower in caffeine. Just ask the barista and we will guide you.

faqs.q: Do I need to book a table?
faqs.a: Walk-ins are always welcome, but weekends fill up fast. Reserve online for guaranteed seating — tables are held for 15 minutes past your booking time.
We pour Tuesday to Sunday, 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM. Mondays we are closed so our roasters can focus on the week’s fresh batches.

faqs.q: Is the café laptop and pet friendly?
faqs.a: Laptops are welcome at our long communal table and window bar before 5 PM on weekends. Well-behaved dogs are welcome on the garden patio.
Absolutely — we host intimate birthdays, tastings and small team offsites for up to 30 guests. Write to hello@mycafe.in with your date and headcount.

faqs.q: Do you have dairy-free milk alternatives?
faqs.a: Yes! We offer barista-grade oat and almond milk for all hot brews, nitro colds and lattes at no extra charge.

faqs.q: Are there vegan or gluten-free options?
faqs.a: Our menu marks vegan (VEGAN) and gluten-free (GF) items clearly. The cold brew, pour over and several brunch plates are naturally vegan. Please note our kitchen handles wheat, nuts and dairy.

faqs.q: Is the bakery really baked fresh every day?
faqs.a: Every morning from 4 AM. Sourdough ferments for 48 hours; croissants are laminated over three days. When a tray sells out, it sells out.

faqs.q: Can I purchase freshly roasted beans or ground powder?
faqs.a: Yes, our freshly roasted whole beans and custom grinds (French Press, AeroPress, South Indian Filter, Espresso) are packed to order at the café counter in 250 g and 1 kg bags.
We ship roasted beans pan-India within 24 hours of roasting. Orders over ₹1,200 ship free. Drop us a note via the contact page to place an order.
We run a monthly Slow Coffee Workshop — covering pour-over, filter coffee and milk texturing. Seats are limited; subscribe to The Slow Letter to hear first.

timeline.title: A tiny counter, one grinder
timeline.text: MY.CAFÉ opens as a 12-seat counter on Artisanal Lane, serving only filter coffee and two bakes.

timeline.title: We start roasting
timeline.text: A second-hand roaster arrives. We begin sourcing directly from shade-grown estates in Coorg and Chikmagalur.

timeline.title: The sourdough programme
timeline.text: A 48-hour fermentation bakery opens behind the bar. The cardamom bun is born — and sells out by 10 AM.

timeline.title: Nitro & the cold bar
timeline.text: We install our first nitro tap and launch the Kaapi Nitro Cold, now our most-ordered drink.

timeline.title: The new roastery café
timeline.text: We expand into a light-filled two-floor space with a patio, roastery window and the Slow Brunch menu.
